description: The people worth reconnecting with, already filtered and ranked in code. Use it for any ask about who to follow up with, reconnect with or re-engage, and build the list only from what it returns. Set `purpose` to `prospects` when the ask is about prospects, leads, lost deals or clients; otherwise leave it as `catch_up`. Both apply the market the user confirmed: anyone it rules out is in `left_out`. A catch-up never judges friends, family or colleagues on fit. Returns `people` (best first), `fit_unknown` (fit could not be decided from saved data; list these apart under a 'Fit unknown' heading, never mixed into the main list), `left_out` (who was dropped and why), `market` (`confirmed` false means it is only their profile) and `assumption` (say it once when it is not null). Every person has `why` (a fit reason and a warmth reason, both from saved data: use it as given), `fit`, `score` with the `features` behind it, `last_contact_on` in the user's own timezone and `source`, where the silence was measured. Keep the order. When `last_contact_on` is null the date is not known: give no date and no day count for that person. Each call marks who it returned as shown. While mail history is still being read the result carries `coverage`, `ready_now` (up to three people from sources already read, each with its `source`) and a `note`: follow the note.

days.description: Quiet for at least this many days. Default 90.

limit.description: People in the main list (default 5, max 10).

purpose.description: `prospects` for prospects, leads, lost deals or clients; `catch_up` (default) for any other follow-up ask.
